# Support matrix

What CI actually executes versus what is merely believed to work
(`docs/spec/08-distribution-and-project.md`, "Compatibility posture").
The floor is macOS 10.12 on Intel and 11.0 on Apple Silicon (ADR-0002); it
is asserted on every built artifact by `scripts/check-deployment-target.sh`.

| macOS | Intel x86_64 | Apple Silicon arm64 |
|---|---|---|
| 10.12 Sierra | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.13 High Sierra | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.14 Mojave | best-effort | unsupported |
| 10.15 Catalina | best-effort | unsupported |
| 11 Big Sur | best-effort | best-effort |
| 12 Monterey | best-effort | best-effort |
| 13 Ventura | best-effort | best-effort |
| 14 Sonoma | best-effort | best-effort |
| 15 Sequoia | tested | tested |
| 26 Tahoe | tested | tested |

- **tested**: a hosted runner with that macOS major and architecture runs
  the full suite natively (`macos-26`, `macos-26-intel`, `macos-15`, `macos-15-intel`).
- **best-effort**: the deployment floor is met and checked on the artifacts,
  and nothing executes there. macOS 10.12 to 10.15 have no hosted runner
  under GitHub's image policy (`docs/research/R-10-ci-runners.md`,
  read 2026-09-02); verification on real hardware is welcome.
- **unsupported**: below the floor.
